===Pokémon: Twilight Wings===
[[File:Sonia Twilight Wings.png|thumb|250px|Sonia in Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]
In ''[[TW04|Early-Evening Waves]]'', Sonia comforted [[Nessa]] after the latter's defeat in the [[Galar League|Champion Cup]]. She later talked to Nessa on the phone and learned about her future plans as a [[Gym Leader]].

In ''[[TW06|Moonlight]]'', she talked with [[Leon]] over the phone.

In ''[[TW07|Sky]]'', she watched the battle between Leon and [[Raihan]] with her {{p|Yamper}}.

In ''[[TW08|The Gathering of Stars]]'', she set off for the [[Crown Tundra]]. Before leaving, she handed [[Hop]] an invitation letter for the [[Galarian Star Tournament]].
